concepts.definition: One team has more skaters because the other took a penalty.
concepts.exampleLine: They have to score on this power play.

concepts.definition: Shooting the puck from your half past the far goal line. Play stops.
concepts.exampleLine: That's icing. Faceoff back in their zone.

concepts.definition: Three goals by one player in a game. Fans throw hats on the ice.
concepts.exampleLine: He just got a hat trick!

concepts.definition: An attacker entering the zone before the puck does.
concepts.exampleLine: Was that offside? It looked close.

concepts.definition: The team a skater down defends until the penalty ends.
concepts.exampleLine: If they kill this penalty, they're back in it.

concepts.definition: The puck is dropped between two players to restart play.

payload.title: Hockey night
payload.setting: She texts you during the game.

exchanges.theirMessage: Oilers are up 2–1. That power play in the 2nd was insane

replies.theirResponse: lol they're only her favorite team
replies.coachNote: Oof. She said their name like you'd know it. Recover with a question.

replies.text: Wait, what makes a power play a big deal?
replies.theirResponse: ok I love that you asked. other team got a penalty so we had an extra skater

replies.text: Being a man up for two minutes and scoring? Huge.
replies.coachNote: Smooth. You just explained a power play back to her.

exchanges.theirMessage: if they win tonight I'm going to be unbearable tomorrow

replies.text: Want to watch the next one together?
replies.coachNote: That's the whole point of this app. Well played.

replies.text: Is it a series? Like how many games?
replies.theirResponse: best of 7! we're up 2–1 in the series
replies.coachNote: Nice. Playoffs are best-of-7. Keep going.

payload.closingNote: A power play is a two-minute man advantage after a penalty. Ask about it and you're in the conversation.

units.title: Rink basics
units.summary: Power plays, icing and why the crowd groans.

lessons.title: Know your penalties.
lessons.objective: You can explain a power play and icing.

payload.prompt: Match the term to what it means.

pairs.definition: One team has an extra skater
Puck shot past the far goal line; play stops

distractorDefinitions: A trick shot behind the net

explanation.summary: Three terms you'll hear every game.
explanation.sayThisLine: That power play goal changed the game.

statement.speaker: Maya
statement.text: If we kill this penalty, we're right back in it.

payload.question: What is she talking about?

options.text: Her team defending a man down

payload.translation: Her team has a player in the penalty box, and if they defend well until it ends, the game stays close.

followUps.line: Their penalty kill has been solid all year.
followUps.why: Shows you know the phrase without pretending to be an expert.

payload.prompt: Put the icing sequence in order.

items.text: A player shoots the puck from their own half
It crosses the far goal line untouched
The whistle blows and play stops
Faceoff back in the shooting team's zone
items.why: The team that iced it doesn't get to change players.

explanation.incorrect: It goes shoot, cross the far line, whistle, then a faceoff back in their zone.

lessons.title: Talk it out.
lessons.objective: You can answer a text about the game.
